meta.title: InnerOutliner - Outline. Focus. Done.
meta.description: InnerOutliner is a local-first task outliner that turns scattered ideas into executable plans. Private by design - no cloud, no account required.
meta.keywords: InnerOutliner, task outliner, local-first, todo app, task manager, productivity, offline
meta.ogDesc: A local-first task outliner. Your data stays on your device. Always.

hero.lead: Turn scattered thoughts into a clean, executable task structure. Nested outlines, subtasks, reminders - everything stays on your device.

stats.label: No sync delay, no login required

features.heading: Everything you need.
features.subheading: Designed for focused work. No subscriptions to worry about, no data leaving your machine.

items.title: Nested outlines
items.desc: Break any goal into parent tasks and subtasks. Crystal-clear structure.

items.title: Priority pinning
items.desc: Hoist today's most critical items to a dedicated pinned area. Stay laser-focused.

items.title: Reminders & due dates
items.desc: Per-task deadlines and local notifications. Never miss a follow-up again.

items.title: Drag & reorder
items.desc: Restructure your lists and sublists instantly with fluid drag-and-drop.

items.title: Progress trends
items.desc: Visual timeline reports reveal your completion rhythm week by week

items.title: Multi-language UI
items.desc: Switch the entire interface language in one tap - 10 locales and growing.

showcase.heading: See it
showcase.subheading: A closer look at the interface - nested lists, dark mode, custom themes, and progress tracking.
